about: A ceiling in a different unit from the quantity it caps.

  periods:
    kind: input
    decided: definition
    unit: dimensionless
    value: 5
    provenance: {kind: fact, source: definition}
  compounded:
    kind: grown
    unit: request/second

    rate: factor
